title: Myanmar Rejects ASEAN Call to Free Aung San Suu Kyi, Questions Need for Special Envoy
detail: Myanmar's Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a statement on August 8, 2026 rejecting the ASEAN Chair's renewed call for Aung San Suu Kyi's unconditional release and for granting access to ASEAN special envoy Philippine FM Ma. Theresa Lazaro, calling the request 'interference' in Myanmar's 'judicial process' and sovereign affairs. The statement further asserted that the special envoy role was 'no longer necessary,' hardening the junta's diplomatic posture just two days after Min Aung Hlaing's Bangkok visit sought to project growing regional legitimacy.

media.caption: Myanmar rejects ASEAN's call for Aung San Suu Kyi's release and questions the need for a special envoy.
